'''''The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai''''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] that depicted the exploits of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] during the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]], an engagement that was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
